The Underground Spring

The observatory's book says that bathing a magical object in underground water can restore its energy. These waters often flow past magical stones and metals and absorb their power.

Objectives

Reach the far end of the cave

Bathe the orb in the western spring

Bathe the orb in the central spring

Bathe the orb in the eastern spring
